definition_title: Counting and asymptotics of unweighted integer simplices
natural_language_statement: unweightedSimplex d N is the finite set of functions Fin d → ℕ whose coordinate sum is at most N. Its cardinality is (N + d).choose d. For fixed d, both that cardinality divided by N^d and the cardinality after replacing N by N + c divided by N^d tend to 1 / d! as N tends to infinity; the bundle also records the corresponding normalized binomial-coefficient limits.
explanation: The exact count follows by adjoining a slack coordinate to convert the sum-at-most constraint into a weak composition of N. The binomial-coefficient asymptotics then give the leading normalized growth of the simplex count, including a fixed additive shift.
